task.ques: Find a recipe for a healthy avocado salad on Allrecipes that has a preparation time of less than 20 minutes and more than 30 user reviews. Include the nutritional information per serving.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Cucumber and Avocado Salad on Allrecipes meets the request: 15 minutes of prep (less than 20) and 230 user reviews (more than 30). This vegetable-and-avocado salad uses citrus juice for dressing and provides 8 g of fiber per serving.

Recipe: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/85881/tangy-cucumber-and-avocado-salad/
Prep time: 15 minutes. Total time: 15 minutes. Yield: 4 servings.
User reviews: 230 (separate from its 296 ratings; average rating 4.7/5).

Nutrition per serving: 186 calories; total fat 15 g; saturated fat 2 g; carbohydrates 16 g; dietary fiber 8 g; total sugars 3 g; protein 3 g; sodium 157 mg; potassium 691 mg; vitamin C 25 mg; calcium 45 mg; iron 1 mg.

Evidence: Allrecipes recipe page and expanded Nutrition Facts (per serving), checked October 27, 2026. final.png shows the recipe name, 230 reviews and 15-minute prep time together in one unobstructed viewport.
